lessons.rule: Tactical and conditioned-game text must teach today's topic in scoring or a constraint, not only in the title.
lessons.because: Tactical/conditioned text never teaches topic "Finding a teammate nearby who can help" (title-sticker / generic session)

lessons.rule: The TACTICAL title and description must be about today's topic, not only the game model.
lessons.because: Tactical drill does not center topic "Finding a teammate nearby who can help"

lessons.rule: CONDITIONED_GAME scoring or a constraint must be false if you swapped today's topic for a different subject.
lessons.because: Conditioned game does not force topic "Finding a teammate nearby who can help" via scoring or constraints

lessons.rule: WARMUP and TECHNICAL must teach today's topic via scoring or a constraint. No generic rondo or 3v3 with the topic only in the title.
lessons.because: Instructor: U16 rest-defence warmup was a perimeter rondo; technical was 3v3 duels. Topic lived only in tactical/game (scores stuck at 4).

lessons.rule: If a title names a layout (channels, middle third, rest-defence shape), setupSteps must mark it. Waiting players are a second group or in the topic, never idle.
lessons.because: Designer/instructor: 'channels' with no channels marked; 3v3x2 left ~10 idle; tactical said middle third on a full 120x80.

lessons.rule: Do not reuse PRIOR grids or scoring stems. Change activity type (not a retitled rondo). New score must still force today's topic.
lessons.because: Practice form is 85% the same as a prior session on this topic (grid/numbers/scoring/constraints). Change the form.

lessons.rule: TACTICAL is a reduced problem grid, not a second full-format match. Only CONDITIONED_GAME is 11v11 on the full pitch.
lessons.because: Designer: U16 rest-defence tactical was a second 120x80 11v11. Realism 2. Isolate middle third on a reduced grid.

lessons.rule: If the squad is bigger than one working group, TECHNICAL setupSteps name a second group on the same score. No idle spectators.
lessons.because: Designer: technical was 7 shirts on 35x40 with a 22-player squad idle. Realism 2.

lessons.rule: If the squad is bigger than one working group, WARMUP/TECHNICAL setupSteps name a second group on the same score. No idle spectators.
lessons.because: TECHNICAL shows 6 working vs squad 22; setupSteps must name a second group, not idle spectators

lessons.rule: CONDITIONED_GAME scoring must not copy PRIOR's time-bonus (no same N-second counterpress multiplier). Score rest-defence shape a new way.
lessons.because: Development: U16 game reused 6-second middle-third counterpress = 3 points from the prior hour. Variety 3.

lessons.rule: USSF_D: describe every action in plain grass words a parent on the sideline would understand. No coaching-manual vocabulary, no borrowed tactical labels.
TECHNICAL setupSteps must describe only what the diagram/grid actually enables — do not narrate an action the layout cannot produce.
lessons.because: U11 review: judge flagged a structural mismatch between the technical drill's description and its physical layout.

lessons.rule: Even without an exact clone, differ meaningfully in practice form from PRIOR — do not reuse the same grid/scoring shape with new labels.
lessons.because: U11 review: judge scored variety 3/5, several drills closely mirrored the prior hour without tripping the frozen clone gate.
